title: Oil-worker action against sale of Rlam refinery
location: Trevo da Resistência on BA-523, access route to Refinaria Landulpho Alves (Rlam), Bahia
organizer: Refinery workers; local union involvement is reported, exact event organizing roster unclear
threshold_50_evidence: No demonstrator count. The article’s 1,700 contracted and 900 direct workers are workforce figures, not event attendees.

start_date.summary: Sindipetro Bahia press-office material published 9 Feb reports an action taking place the morning of 10 Feb against sale/privatization of Rlam. Direct and contracted employees participated; nearby residents, businesses and legislators were invited, but their attendance is not confirmed. The article cites 1,700 contracted and 900 direct employees as workforce totals, not demonstrators. No event headcount is given.

title: Multi-city actions for vaccines, emergency aid and Bolsonaro removal
location: Multiple reported locations across all five Brazilian regions; specific local boundaries require review
organizer: Frente Brasil Popular, Frente Povo sem Medo, CUT and other movements as described by CUT
threshold_50_evidence: No person turnout is reported in the read body. Maceió’s approximately 100 vehicles are not a person count.

start_date.summary: CUT reports actual actions on 20 Feb across Brazil’s five regions, including caravans, bicycle actions, street concentrations, banners and public events, demanding vaccines, emergency aid and Bolsonaro’s removal. The same report lists proposed locations for 21 Feb separately; those plans are not coded as executed. Fortaleza and Porto Alegre events were reported cancelled for 20 Feb.

title: Student actions against education cuts and for vaccination
location: Sobral, Natal, São Luís, Belém, Santarém, Brasília, Belo Horizonte, Rio de Janeiro, Niterói, Porto Alegre, São Paulo, São Carlos, Ribeirão Preto and Caçapava
organizer: Juntos! student movement and local student organizers; precise local roster unclear
threshold_50_evidence: No local or aggregate person count in the read body; public participation at each listed action is not quantified.

start_date.summary: A Juntos! retrospective published 26 Feb reports student actions on 25 Feb in the listed cities, including events, open mics, leafleting and banners. Reported demands address education and social-spending cuts, a proposed constitutional amendment, vaccination/public health, emergency aid and Bolsonaro. The body does not state a participant count or establish whether local actions form one coordinated event or several local events.

title: Belo Horizonte municipal-worker vaccination action
location: Belo Horizonte, Minas Gerais; venue not stated
organizer: SINDIBEL, which says it promoted the action
threshold_50_evidence: No participant count. The union calls it symbolic; occupational group size is not attendance.

start_date.summary: SINDIBEL reports that it promoted a symbolic action on 24 Feb demanding vaccination for municipal workers in highly exposed jobs omitted from the city plan. The union says it notified the federal health minister and the municipal health secretary. No turnout, venue, end time or government response outcome is stated.
